basic_info.description: Video Preview! Northern edge of Pacific Heights, flat block close to Union St, built in 1997, 4 bed, 4 1/2 bath. Stone stairs lead from the sidewalk up to a private landing overlooking Vallejo. Four story home has living floor in the middle. Enter the foyer and up the stairs to the open living level with a dining room, wood burning fireplace and living room with bay windows. Powder room and updated kitchen are on the south side. Kitchen opens to the garden with an outdoor TV. Primary bedroom suite is on the top of the home facing north with French doors opening out to a Juliette balcony and a view of Alcatraz. The suite has built-in closets, a remodeled spacious bathroom with skylights. There is an en-suite bedroom on the south side. On the first living floor, there are two en-suite bedrooms and laundry. Rear bedroom opens to a patio. Internal stairs lead down to the mud room and a large two car garage with great storage.
